project_type: Next.js 14 App Router with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
test_framework: None found in package.json - no test framework configured
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation and no build errors. Run npm run dev and visually verify the light theme in browser at http://localhost:3000
snapshot_or_generated_files: Next.js generates .next/ build artifacts. These are in .gitignore and should not be committed.
environment_constraints: Frontend dev server runs on port 3000. Backend API expected on port 8000. No tests to run, verification is visual + build check.
contribution_requirements: Project uses TypeScript strict mode. All components must maintain TypeScript type safety. shadcn/ui components use CSS variables from globals.css for theming.
key_patterns: Pages use 'use client' directive when using hooks. Dark theme implemented via: (1) className='dark' on html tag in layout.tsx, (2) dark mode CSS variables in globals.css :root, (3) hardcoded dark classes like bg-[#0F172A], bg-slate-900, bg-slate-800, text-white, border-slate-800 throughout components. shadcn/ui components reference CSS variables via Tailwind config. Auth pages (login/register) are standalone with full-page dark backgrounds. Dashboard and other pages use Navbar component.
directory_structure: src/app/ contains pages using App Router (page.tsx files). src/components/ has reusable components. src/components/ui/ contains shadcn/ui primitives. src/lib/ has API client, auth context, types. All .tsx files are TypeScript React components.
